fusions.name: Latch Shut
fusions.desc: You leap up to 6 tiles onto the target and strike with your weapon for 12 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and 30% slower for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Feeding Pen
fusions.desc: Bars close around you, dealing 24 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, ignoring armour, and leaving them [Pinned] for 2 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Slip the Bars
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions that hold or stop you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Kept by No One
fusions.desc: Each affliction laid on you has a 25% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.
